trust_decision.summary: startViewer decides how the output file name reaches the OS viewer; before the fix it was interpolated into an os.system shell string, after it it is passed as one argv element (subprocess.run list / os.startfile).

landing_point.why: The summary names startViewer; it is the only shell sink in the package and sits in the CLI module.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API xhtml2pdf.pisa.startViewer(filename), and CLI xhtml2pdf -s/--start-viewer via execute() (xhtml2pdf/pisa.py:273-275, xhtml2pdf/pisa.py:459-462)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No second route exists to argue away; the only remaining nuance (a filename beginning with '-' reaching open/xdg-open as an option) is unreachable from the CLI because dest is made absolute at xhtml2pdf/pisa.py:428.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Opening real file names containing spaces, quotes or other unusual characters in the default viewer, and the no-op on an empty name; a fix that rejects or escapes such names breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: file name with shell metacharacters (quotes, ;, #) on POSIX

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second viewer/opener helper (e.g. for an XML-output or debug-dump file) built with os.system or shell=True
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the original helper was written exactly that way (fix.diff:5739); a maintainer adding a 'show XML' option could copy the old idiom

O8b_injection_room.sibling: dest derived from a remote src URL's host+path, fed to the viewer without the abspath step
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the URL-derived name is attacker-influenced and only becomes safe-ish for option injection because of xhtml2pdf/pisa.py:428

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78) via shell string interpolation of a file name

O10_build.toolchain: pip / pyproject (reportlab, pypdf, html5lib etc.), pytest/unittest
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_cli.py:183-239 StartViewerTest (mocks os.system, subprocess.run, os.startfile); already present at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: shlex.quote the name inside the existing os.system call, or reject names with metacharacters

out_of_scope_notes: The pinned commit f86380d IS the fix commit (HEAD of the tree); xhtml2pdf/pisa.py:465-484 already contains the fixed startViewer, so the vulnerable code is absent. The real pre-fix parent is 1b7a021.
The fix commit f86380d is a large 'Development' merge that also adds an SSRF/local-file resource policy (fix.diff:5612-5702, xhtml2pdf/config/resources.py); that is a different advisory surface.
testrender/testrender.py:184 uses Popen in a dev tool; not part of the shipped package.
docs/source/release-notes.rst:76 says startViewer is reachable from '-d', but -d is --debug (xhtml2pdf/pisa.py:285); the viewer flag is -s (xhtml2pdf/pisa.py:273).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell commands run); tiny_repo flag not assessed.
Whether 1b7a021 lacks tests/test_cli.py StartViewerTest was not checked against that commit's tree; inferred from fix.diff:1250-1355 adding them.
Whether xdg-open/open interpret a leading '-' argument via direct startViewer API calls was not checked; the fix adds no '--' separator (xhtml2pdf/pisa.py:482).
